measure.name: contam_infiltration_report
measure.description: Reports the infiltration a CONTAM-coupled run produced, per building and per zone.
measure.modeler_description: Calls osm2contam (python -m osm2contam comstock-reduce) on run/osm2contam and eplusout.sql. Registers building values; writes zones.csv and zone_hourly.csv.gz into run/osm2contam. Not applicable unless contam_coupled_infiltration ran in coupled mode. The Python interpreter is OSM2CONTAM_PYTHON if set, else python (Windows) or python3.
